name: Mock Server
description: Run a local mock HTTP server from inside Voiden — define routes with a status, headers, body and optional delay, point your frontend, client or tests at it, and watch the requests that hit it.
author: Voiden Team
readme: Open the Mock Server tab in the left sidebar, add routes (method + path → status, headers, body, delay) and press Start. Routes are saved in voiden-mocks.json at the project root, so they can be committed and shared. Supports :param and * wildcards in paths, CORS for browser apps, optional LAN access, live route edits while running, and a log of every incoming request.

sidebar.description: Left sidebar panel to start/stop the server, edit routes and view the request log

mainProcess.description: Runs the HTTP server in the Electron main process and reads/writes voiden-mocks.json in the active project

features: Start and stop a local mock HTTP server from Voiden (default http://127.0.0.1:4010)
Routes with method (or ANY), path, status code, response headers, body and delay
Path patterns with :params and trailing * wildcards; first matching route wins
Routes saved in voiden-mocks.json at the project root — commit and share them
Route edits apply live while the server runs; hand edits to the file are picked up too
Optional response delay to test slow backends and timeouts
CORS headers and automatic preflight handling for browser frontends
Optional LAN mode to reach the mock from a phone or VM
Request log with headers, body, matched route and timing; add a route straight from an unmatched request
